issues.description: The parameter order of teleport_s differs between the problem statement/solution and the template stub. The problem statement and the solution implement teleport_s(circ, data_qubit, injection_qubit, p=0.0) (data_qubit first), but the template stub declares teleport_s(circ, injection_qubit, data_qubit, p=0.0) (injection_qubit first). This inconsistency will confuse students about the expected argument order and can lead to failing tests or incorrect implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template stub match the problem statement and solution by changing the teleport_s signature in msd.py to def teleport_s(circ: stim.Circuit, data_qubit: int, injection_qubit: int, p: float = 0.0) -> int:. Alternatively, update the problem statement to use the order used in the template, but prefer aligning the template to the documented API.
